intro: The Prodigal Lich Returns marks the conclusion of the effort to recruit Gunther Arcanus into the Forsaken. Having proven your intentions and restored his grimoire, you carry an arcane communion gem back to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this :Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor. It will let us communicate... And I have much to tell him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you returned Gunther's book? Has he responded?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You convinced him to join us! You have done a great deed for the Forsaken, friend. The Dark Lady will be informed.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
